It pairs a 16" touchscreen with a convertible hinge, 16GB of memory, and a 512GB SSD. My Best Buy members get free shipping on all orders (it's free to join). Deal ends November 28. Buy Now at Best Buy Features 16" 1920 x 1200 touchscreen display Intel Core Ultra 5 Series 2 processor 16GB RAM & 512GB SSD Windows 11 Home
